Combined with YBLOCK=8 (very small), the grid is (1, 1664) with only 0.79 waves on 132 SMs. The scheduler reports 50.52% of cycles have no eligible warp, directly caused by this tile shape mismatch. Shrinking XBLOCK to 16 (wastes only 7 threads) and increasing YBLOCK to 64-256 gives each block more real work and improves occupancy.

This wastes 93% of each warp's lanes in the X-dimension, directly causing the 50.52% issue-slot stall rate and the 55.3% achieved occupancy (vs 100% theoretical). The grid is (1, 1664) = 1664 CTAs across 132 SMs = 0.79 waves, barely one full wave. Shrinking XBLOCK to 16 (next power-of-2 >= 9) and increasing YBLOCK eliminates the wasted lanes. Adding @triton.autotune explores XBLOCK=16 with YBLOCK=8/16/32/64/128 to find the best tile shape for this 9x13312 problem.
